website.note: Diagnostics products: GraftAssureCore, GraftAssureDx, GraftAssureIQ, VitaGraft Kidney, VitaGraft Liver, DetermaCNI, DetermaIO

no_active_clinical_pipeline_reason: Insight Molecular Diagnostics is a molecular diagnostics company focused on transplant monitoring and oncology assays (donor-derived cfDNA, gene expression). It develops in vitro diagnostic tests, not therapeutics, and runs no Phase 1-3 drug clinical trials. GraftAssureDx was submitted to FDA as a de novo IVD device, not a drug.
